name: Flyer maker
summary: Make a paper flyer for the group's corkboard; members tear off tabs to say they want it.
useWhen: someone in a big group is giving away, selling, looking for or announcing something
'free couch, who wants it', 'lost my airpods', 'pickup soccer sunday'
dontUseWhen: a sale with prices and several items (use move-out-sale)
an event with a date people RSVP to

heads.description: 1 to 4 flyer texts to cycle: head (short, any case, e.g. 'FREE COUCH') and sub (one line of detail)

board.description: Up to 3 flyers already on the board: head, paper (0-7), by (name)

week.description: Flyers pinned and tabs torn in the group this week, e.g. { flyers: 38, tabs: 212 }
